ui_mrp.output_hint: What this formula makes. It can be a finished product to sell, or a semi-finished item used in other formulas.
ui_mrp.batch_hint: How much one run of this formula makes. Components below are for this amount.
ui_mrp.overhead_hint: General costs such as power and rent, as a % of material cost.
ui_mrp.advanced_hint: Setup amount: a fixed extra used once per production order (e.g. line flushing). Rounding: the need is rounded up to this multiple (e.g. 25 kg bags).
ui_mrp.multilevel_hint: A component can be a semi-finished item with its own formula. The planner makes it first when stock is short.
ui_mrp.byproducts_hint: Other items this run also produces (e.g. bran, whey). They are added to stock and take the share of the cost you set.
ui_mrp.share_too_high: The by-products' total share of cost must be under 100%.
ui_mrp.stages_hint: Write the steps in the order they happen, e.g. prep → cook → plate, or weigh → mix → heat → fill → label → pack. Times and rates are optional but give you time and cost estimates.
ui_mrp.stages_empty: No stages yet. Add your first stage or start from a template.
ui_mrp.capacity_hint: Units per run: how many output units one run handles (0 = one batch).
ui_mrp.save_for_analysis: Save the formula to see selling price, margin, real yield and how many you can make from current stock.
ui_mrp.dirty_hint: You have unsaved changes. These numbers are for the saved version.
ui_mrp.actual_vs_standard: Real average cost per unit {{actual}} vs. formula cost {{standard}}
ui_mrp.not_sold: This item is not on sale yet. Create a sales product linked to it; produced stock then shows up in POS and the catalogue.
ui_mrp.sell_no_category: You have no category yet; create one with the "Categories" button.
ui_mrp.templates_hint: Pick the closest one. It fills in stages and components; you can change everything afterwards. Components are matched to your items by name.
ui_mrp.describe_hint: Write one step per line: amounts with units become components, times become stage time, and the rest becomes the stage name. Nothing is saved until you check it.
ui_mrp.describe_example:
mix 10kg water with 2kg SLES for 15 min in mixer
heat to 70 °C for 30 min
۱۰ کیلو آب و ۲ کیلو نمک را ۱۵ دقیقه در میکسر مخلوط کن
ui_mrp.describe_nothing: No steps found. Write one step per line.
ui_mrp.plan_hint: Choose products and amounts. You get the materials needed across every level, what is short, what to buy, which semi-finished items to make first, time and cost.
ui_mrp.plan_ok: Everything is in stock. You can start production.
ui_mrp.create_orders_text: {{count}} production orders will be created (semi-finished items as sub-orders). Stock does not change until each order is completed.
ui_mrp.create_orders_hint: Creates one order per item to make, with the stages of its production line.
ui_mrp.actual_minutes_hint: Leave the time empty to use the time since the stage started.
ui_mrp.scrap_output_hint: Units lost at the end of the line. Recorded for the yield and scrap report.
